name: Superwhisper
tagline: Dictate your messages and drafts directly into apps with local or cloud models.
description:
Superwhisper is a voice-to-text utility that lets you dictate into the app or text field already in front of you. A shortcut starts recording, then the app turns speech into text that can be inserted into Slack, email, documents, chat tools, and other macOS applications.

It is built for writing at speaking speed while keeping the destination app in place. That makes it useful for rough drafts, long messages, meeting follow-ups, prompts, and notes where typing would interrupt the flow of a thought.

## Features

- Start dictation with a global shortcut and insert transcribed text into the active app or website.
- Use voice modes and writing controls to adapt spoken input for different kinds of writing, such as messages, notes, or more polished drafts.
- Dictate across macOS, Windows, and iOS, with the current availability and plan details determined by Superwhisper’s release and subscription options.
- Keep the speaking workflow close to the cursor instead of moving text through a separate recording or transcription app.
- Use personal vocabulary and language settings when supported by the selected model and current release.
- Review and refine the resulting text when names, technical terms, punctuation, or context need a human check.

## Where it fits

Superwhisper is best for people who regularly compose text but find spoken first drafts faster than typing. It works particularly well for solo writing, messages, email, and quick capture across many apps.

It is not a replacement for careful editing or a dedicated meeting-transcription workflow. Accuracy and available controls can depend on the chosen model, language, audio conditions, and current plan.

## Privacy and requirements

Superwhisper needs microphone access and system permission to insert text into other applications. Its local models can keep audio and transcription on the device, while cloud models, user-supplied API keys, and synchronization features send selected material to the applicable service. Confirm the active model before dictating confidential, regulated, or client-owned information.

## Pricing

Superwhisper includes a free tier. Pro $8.49/month.
